decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-26829751:f01) confirms that MYB::QKI fusions are highly specific to Angiocentric Glioma, being present in 6 of 7 detectable cases among 19 profiled tumors and absent in 147 non-Angiocentric Gliomas. However, the source text does not specify the variant origin (SOMATIC vs. germline) nor does it provide data on the age of onset (Childhood/Juvenile) for the patients. Because the claim includes specific qualifiers regarding variant origin and phenotype that are not addressed or supported by the available evidence, the evidence is insufficient to fully support the claim as written.

citations.quote: In total, all 19 Angiocentric Gliomas profiled by WGS, RNA-seq, WES, FISH, or aCGH displayed MYB alterations, and in six of the seven cases in which its fusion partner could be detected, MYB was fused to QKI. . . . MYB-QKI rearrangements appeared specific to Angiocentric Glioma. None of the 147 non-Angiocentric Gliomas profiled with WGS or RNA-seq exhibited MYB-QKI fusions (p<0.0001, Figure 1c).
